_comment: Target packet skeleton for evm-token-due-diligence. scripts/rpc_probe.py writes the machine-filled fields (tool, generated_at_utc, requested, observed, identity, pin, pinned_block_hex, runtime, metadata, probes, coverage_status, limitations, calls, failed_calls, declarations, notes). You fill deployment, candidate_pools, related_contracts, decision_question, requirement_frame, scope_statement, known_limitations, and _freeze. Keys starting with '_' are documentation: drop them, and drop keys the manifest schema does not allow (runtime.is_contract, runtime.proxy.implementation_code_size, metadata.*.selector, metadata.*.raw), when copying objects into a manifest. Chain ids and every other chain-specific number are as observed from the endpoint and must be verified at use time (eth_chainId at the pin).
_comment_generated_at_utc: UTC time the probe ran, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

requested._comment: Exactly what the user asked for. chain_id (integer) is authoritative; chain_name is a label only. address is as supplied (strict: mixed case must satisfy EIP-55); address_checksum is the EIP-55 form used everywhere else. source = where the address came from (message, file, link).

observed._comment: What the endpoint reported. chain_id = int(eth_chainId), read live, never from cache. rpc_endpoint_redacted comes from ddcore.redact_url; never store the raw URL. client_version = web3_clientVersion when available (non-material).

identity._comment: MATCH when requested.chain_id == observed.chain_id. CHAIN_MISMATCH means stop and report (rpc_probe exits 3 and reads nothing else). UNVERIFIED means the chain id could not be read (coverage limitation; nothing can be pinned). pin_warning appears when the block hash looks like a placeholder.

pin._comment: Primary pin P1 in manifest pin format. block_number, block_hash and timestamp_unix are copied from captured_header, the raw eth_getBlockByNumber result. Every later read uses pinned_block_hex, never 'latest'. Additional chains and historical snapshots get P2..Pn in the manifest, never a replaced P1.

_comment_pinned_block_hex: Hex block number (0x..) passed to every pinned read.

runtime._comment: Target runtime at P1. code_hash = keccak256(eth_getCode) (0x + 64 hex); is_contract false with the empty-code hash means the address has no code. proxy.status: not_proxy | eip1967 | eip1822 | beacon | minimal_1167 | custom | unknown. slots_read maps slot -> raw 32-byte value. upgrade_authority stays null until resolved under A-UPGRADE (address + role + threshold/timelock).

metadata._comment: Resolved from the target with eth_call at P1. status: resolved | nonstandard (value kept, decoding basis in reason) | unresolved (value null, reason required). source names the call and pin; selector and raw preserve the request and raw return data (move raw into an evidence row and cite it via evidence_id when building the manifest). accounting_model is yours to fill from code and behavior: standard_erc20 | rebasing | fee_on_transfer | shares_based | wrapper | unknown.

_comment_probes: Standard probes owner(), getOwner(), paused() plus each --call (a --call repeating a standard probe is read once). Element shape in _element_shapes.probe. status: ok | reverted | unavailable | empty. A revert is a fact about the contract at P1, not a limitation; unavailable means the read failed and a limitation was recorded.

deployment._comment: Not derivable from standard JSON-RPC reads. Discover via explorer/trace tooling, then verify by receipt (contractAddress == target) and record provenance; until then status stays unresolved with the reason. deterministic = true when created via CREATE2/factory with a derivable address.
deployment.reason: deployment transaction is not derivable from standard JSON-RPC reads; discover it via explorer/trace tooling, then verify by receipt (contractAddress) and record provenance

_comment_candidate_pools: Pools from the architecture pass, each by exact address (v2/v3) or full pool key + derived PoolId (v4). Element shape in _element_shapes.candidate_pool. Canonical vs side is decided under B-CANON/B-SIDE, not here.
_comment_related_contracts: Every contract or key that can change balances, restrict transfers, remove principal, upgrade behavior, collect fees, allocate rewards, or enforce claimed utility. Element shape = manifest scope_addresses entry (see _element_shapes.related_contract) so it can be copied unchanged.
_comment_requirement_frame: The standard the verdict is judged against, e.g. 'rug resistance for a 30-day hold' or 'exit of 0.5% of supply within 5% degradation'.
_comment_scope_statement: What is in and out of scope (chains, pools, reward layers, time bounds).
materiality_rules: Monetary thresholds never apply to discovery of mint, upgrade, seizure, transfer-restriction, arbitrary-call, or LP-removal authority.
_comment_known_limitations: Free-text limitations known before starting (no archive endpoint, no explorer API, no parallel agents).
_comment_coverage_status: complete when limitations is empty, otherwise partial.
_comment_limitations: Manifest-shaped coverage limitations L1..Ln (see _element_shapes.limitation). Never token findings.
_comment_calls: Every successful RPC call {method, params, cached} for replay.
_comment_failed_calls: Every failed call {method, params, cached, outcome (reverted|limitation), error_kind, error_message, limitation_id}.

_freeze._comment: Filled when the packet is frozen: sha256 of this file computed with the three values below set to null; frozen_at_utc; frozen_by (agent/session label, no personal data). After freezing, the packet is read-only; a new target or pin means a new packet.

candidate_pool.provenance: event_derived | rpc_derived | explorer_label | website_claim | inferred | user_supplied
candidate_pool.provenance_detail: e.g. PoolCreated log tx 0x.. block N; verify factory and init code hash at use time

related_contract.role: token | implementation | proxy_admin | beacon | owner | role_holder | multisig | timelock | pool | pool_manager | position_manager | position_nft | locker | hook | router | quoter | factory | launch_platform | curve | treasury | fee_recipient | vault | reward_distributor | bridge | oracle | deployer | launch_signer | funder | holder | burn | exchange_deposit | other
related_contract.provenance: user_supplied | rpc_derived | event_derived | explorer_label | website_claim | inferred

limitation.kind: rpc_timeout | rpc_rate_limit | rpc_pruned | rpc_error | dns_failure | api_unavailable | explorer_unavailable | source_unavailable | out_of_scope | other
